ruleDefinitions.name: Win Susp Computer Name Containing Samtheadmin
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious computer name samtheadmin-{1..100}$ generated by hacktool Note: Unmapped fields: SamAccountName

sequences.query: ((SamAccountName = RGX("^SAMTHEADMIN\\-") AND SamAccountName = RGX("\\$$")) OR (dest_user = RGX("^SAMTHEADMIN\\-") AND dest_user = RGX("\\$$")))
